description.p: Omakade is a local-first game library for Omarchy. It discovers installed Steam, GOG, Lutris, Heroic, Faugus, RetroArch, PCSX2, Ryujinx, and Battle.net games, uses local artwork, follows the active Omarchy theme, and delegates launching back to the owning platform.
The in-game guide's Record clip action now uses its own recorder, so a screen recording started from Omarchy keeps running and is no longer shown or stopped by the guide.
The guide shows GPU load on NVIDIA cards.
Controller navigation is fixed across Home, Settings and Stats: one press moves one step, every control can be reached, and Back from Settings returns to the screen you opened it from.
With Steam running, controller presses no longer count twice.
Press Home or Super + Ctrl + G over a running game to open the in-game guide. The game pauses while it is open. Resume, take screenshots and clips, adjust sound, check performance or quit.

In Game Mode, Desktop takes you to the desktop and Home brings you back to the paused game with the guide open. Holding Home works as Home did in 1.15. Also fixes Sunshine exports, Heroic GOG imports and OmaStore playtime.
Adds an optional Controller Home button setting: the Xbox, PlayStation or Home button on any controller starts Game Mode, returns to the desktop and resumes, like the keyboard shortcut.
The button works while a game has focus and when Omakade is closed. It only reads controllers and works alongside Steam Input.
Returns to the desktop and resumes the same Game Mode library page, selection, scroll and focus, with or without a running game.
Keeps running games available with safely attributed audio muted while away, and prepares fullscreen layout before showing the window.
Improves session checks, focus ordering and desktop recovery when audio control fails.
Closes Omakade when leaving Game Mode if Game Mode launched it, restoring the original desktop. An already-open Omakade window stays open.
Adds Game Mode with a chosen display and desktop sound output, notification silencing, and session recovery.
Restores the desktop when leaving and provides in-game controls through a keyboard shortcut.
Sorts installed games first, dims uninstalled covers, and imports owned Epic, GOG and Amazon games from Heroic.
Reworks browsing and narrow-window layouts, themes native controls, and clarifies Stats and library repair.
Fixes cold-launch controller and keyboard focus, makes Couch navigation follow visible rows, and adds startup and directional regression tests.
Copies verified save backups when relocating game paths and keeps Stop Game limited to attributable running targets.
Adds local statistics and a shareable Year in Review, session history, verified game stopping, optional Discord presence, and native melonDS, RPCS3, and PPSSPP sources.
Adds live Dolphin and PCSX2 attribution, observed activity intervals, durable session recovery, and fixes for artwork recovery and playtime accounting.
Xbox 360 games through Xenia, and an optional TV gaming agent skill.
Optional ProtonDB tier badges on library cards.
Fix RomM catalog refresh on large libraries.
RomM integration, per-game launch setup, save management, and guided library repair.

ul.li: Protect supported emulator save sets before launch with versioned snapshots and recoverable restores.
Connect a read-only RomM library with local files and offline catalog retention.
Save per-installation launch choices and repair missing game paths.
Review save coverage, configure layouts, and manage backup retention.
Work through library repairs with separate identity and artwork undo.
Show optional cached ProtonDB community reports in game details.
Improve ROM identification, artwork recovery, library review, and console-aware launch selection.

description.p: Optional Home and Up Next, regional game details, unified artwork selection, session recording, and expanded personal-data backups.
Console libraries, redesigned settings, personal backups, and optional ratings and portrait covers.

ul.li: Discover GameCube and Wii games with Dolphin, Wii U games with Cemu, and dumped PS4 games with shadPS4.
Switch between console cards and individual games on desktop and in Couch Mode.
Adjust cover sizes and browse sources from the reorganized settings.
Identify games with IGDB, sort by rating, and choose SteamGridDB portrait covers.
Add native games and desktop entries by hand, choose a preferred installation for linked games, and add extra GOG folders.
Customize covers, heroes, and logos, organize several games at once, save library filters, and pick a random game.
Back up and restore personal library choices, settings, and artwork.
Hold the screensaver off while a game launched from Omakade is running.
